text: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.
When Ramadan begins, the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of Hell are closed.
Fasting is a shield; so when one of you is fasting, let him not speak obscenely or act ignorantly.
There is a gate in Paradise called Ar-Rayyan, through which only those who fast will enter.
Whoever gives iftar to a fasting person will have the same reward without reducing theirs.
The supplication of the fasting person is not rejected.
Fasting and the Quran will intercede for the servant on the Day of Resurrection.
Every action of the son of Adam is for him except fasting, for it is for Me and I shall reward it.
Whoever does not give up false speech, Allah has no need of him giving up food and drink.
Seek Laylatul Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan.
The best charity is that given in Ramadan.
Whoever stands in prayer on Laylatul Qadr out of faith, his past sins will be forgiven.
The Prophet was the most generous in Ramadan when Jibreel would meet him.
Ramadan is the month of patience, and patience is rewarded with Paradise.
When the last ten days began, the Prophet would tighten his waist belt and pray all night.
There is nothing equivalent to fasting.
The breath of a fasting person is sweeter to Allah than the scent of musk.
Whoever prays qiyam in Ramadan with faith and seeking reward will be forgiven.
Make dua to Allah with certainty that He will answer.
The strong is not the one who overcomes people, but who controls himself when angry.
Laylatul Qadr is better than a thousand months.
Whoever draws near to Allah with good character is like one who fasts and prays all night.
Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni — O Allah, You are Pardoning…
The one who recites Quran skillfully is with the noble scribes (angels).
Allah extends His hand at night to accept repentance of those who sinned by day.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
Nothing is heavier on the Scale than good character.
The best of you are those who are best to their families.
Charity does not decrease wealth.
Whoever fasts Ramadan then follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted forever.
